'''Nikolaus Hautsch''' (born 1972) is a German [[economist]] and [[statistician]].<ref name=":0" /> Since 2013, he has been [[professor]] of [[finance]] and [[statistics]] at the [[University of Vienna]]<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Neue Professuren im August 2013: Univ.-Prof. Dr. Nikolaus Hautsch |url=https://medienportal.univie.ac.at/uniview/professuren/cv/artikel/univ-prof-dr-nikolaus-hautsch/ |access-date=6 September 2023 |website=[[University of Vienna]]}}</ref> and since 2023, he has been serving as vice rector for infrastructure at the University of Vienna.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 November 2022 |title=Nikolaus Hautsch elected Vice-Rector for Infrastructure at the University of Vienna |url=https://www.vgsf.ac.at/nikolaus-hautsch-elected-vice-rector-for-infrastructure-at-the-university-of-vienna/ |access-date=6 September 2023 |website=Vienna Graduate School of Finance}}</ref> He is known for his work in [[financial econometrics]], the statistical analysis of financial [[high frequency data]] and market microstructure analysis.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=2014 |title=Prof. Dr. Nikolaus Hautsch |url=https://homepage.univie.ac.at/nikolaus.hautsch/ |access-date=6 September 2023 |website=[[University of Vienna]]}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Hautsch was born on March 9, 1972, in [[Singen]] ([[Germany]])<ref name=":0" /> and grew up in [[Radolfzell]].<ref>"Die Besten wandern ab". ''[[Südkurier]].'' 28 July 2004.</ref>

He graduated with a diploma in [[economics]] from the [[University of Konstanz]] in 1998. He earned his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in [[econometrics]] in 2003 from the University of Konstanz.<ref name=":1" />

From 2004 to 2007, he was [[assistant professor]] and [[associate professor]] at the [[University of Copenhagen]]'s Department of Economics.<ref name=":1" /><ref>"Mehr Zeit für die Forschung". ''[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung]].'' 19 October 2011.</ref> From 2007 to 2013 he held the Chair of Econometrics at [[Humboldt University of Berlin]]. In 2013, he joined the University of Vienna as professor of finance and statistics.<ref name=":0" />

Hautsch had visiting positions at the [[University of Technology Sydney]], the [[University of Melbourne]], the [[Université catholique de Louvain]], the [[University of Cambridge]] and [[Duke University]], among others.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2013 |title=CV Nikolaus Hautsch |url=https://homepage.univie.ac.at/nikolaus.hautsch/cv.html |access-date=6 September 2023 |website=[[University of Vienna]]}}</ref>

He is elected [[fellow]] of the Society for Financial Econometrics,<ref name=":0" /> [[research fellow]] of the [[Center for Financial Studies]] (CFS), [[Frankfurt]],<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Mathematics and Finance |url=https://www.wwtf.at/funding/programmes/past/ma/SC10-002/ |access-date=6 September 2023 |website=Wiener Wissenschafts-, Forschungs- und Technologiefonds}}</ref> faculty member of the Vienna Graduate School of Finance,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023 |title=Nikolaus Hautsch |url=https://www.vgsf.ac.at/faculty/vgsf-faculty/nikolaus-hautsch/ |access-date=6 September 2023 |website=Vienna Graduate School of Finance}}</ref> and member of the research platform "Data Science" at the University of Vienna.<ref name=":4">"Den Heiligen Gral beim Rudern finden". ''[[Der Standard]]''. 18 January 2023.</ref>
